page.overview:
Who is Izou?

Izou was the former 16th division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates and prior to this, a retainer of the Wano Country daimyo Kouzuki Oden. He was the older brother of fellow retainer Kikunojo.

He was an ally in both the Marineford and Wano Country Arcs, the latter of which he would ultimately lose his life fighting CP0 agent Maha to prevent him from chasing the Straw Hats.

Izou was a man who had a pale complexion, purple lipstick, and had his black hair tied up in the manner of a geisha with a lock of long, loose hair falling over the right side of his face. He had the crest of the Kouzuki Family tattooed on his back. He was a man who wore a pink and purple kimono and a scarlet obi with black spots tied around his waist.

After the timeskip, he had a small scar over his right eye, his hair appeared longer and he had a second shorter strand of hair hanging over the left side of his face. He also wore a light pink kimono very similar to the previous one with the simplified version of the pirate flag of the Whitebeard Pirates on the legs, along with a purple obi with pink spots, a black cape and black gloves.
